headline: Bag windows now support Blizzard's Gamepad UI in WoW: Forever.

entries.title: Blizzard Gamepad UI support in bag windows
entries.details: Backpack, bank, and Next's vendor and guild bank windows now work with Blizzard's Gamepad UI, with d-pad navigation, triggers, input hints, and radial menu. A buys or sells on vendor cards, X right-clicks, and B returns held items or closes; gamepad mode pauses in combat and switches live with mouse.
